From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>

Subject: Midweek numbers: tactical handoff + 11/11 standup agenda

Team —

Quick midweek nudge on Acme (RDW-ACME-2028-Q4) and the standup agenda for tomorrow. We need final stage confirmations and a short action slate to close the week. Please do the following before 3pm PT today: 

- Update SFDC stage to the most conservative state you can justify (if there is any risk >25%, flag as "At Risk").
- Drop a one-line commit in the deal note: "Commit: $X by EOW / Confidence: 60%" or mark OOF if no realistic close.
- If you're handing off to RevOps for submission, attach the numbers snapshot and call out any blocked items.

I've attached a trimmed snapshot (2028_Q4_numbers_snapshot.xlsx) with per-account recommended commit, best-case, and downside. Marcus — please lead the call tomorrow and start with the three highest-velocity accounts. Neha — bring the updated MAP and any procurement open items. Jonas — I want one quick risk call after the standup for deals >$200k.

Agenda for 11 Oct 2028 standup (15 minutes):
- 0:00–0:03: Quick roll call + top 3 accounts (Marcus)
- 0:03–0:08: Per-account commit line and blockers (owner quick hits)
- 0:08–0:12: Procurement/security blockers (Neha)
- 0:12–0:15: Risk triage + next steps (Jonas)

Please reply with confirmations and attach any docs you want included in the submission. I'll compile and hand to RevOps by 4pm.

Thanks —
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Sales Manager, Revenue
Redwood Inference
